notes: εἰς takes the bare infinitival *to* as the clause-introducer of the articular infinitive under rule 61, and the nominalizing article is unrepresented; rule 24 makes the bare *to* and *to the end that* one analysis.
The repeated infinitival markers on the coordinate infinitives are rule 7 helpers on the verbs they introduce, rules 40 and 103, and are never added.
